claims.claim: Texas Instruments Q2 2026 revenue rose 23% YoY to $5.463B, led by broad growth in industrial, data center and automotive; operating profit rose 48%.
Trailing-12-month operating cash flow was $8.7B and free cash flow $6.5B while TI continued 300mm manufacturing investment, supporting a scale/cost-control thesis in analog semiconductors.

risks.risk: Analog demand remains cyclical and capacity investment can depress returns if industrial/automotive recovery stalls.

unknowns.unknown: Current utilization and incremental returns on new 300mm capacity are not quantified here.

claims.claim: Execution improved sharply with 23% revenue growth, 48% operating-profit growth and a Q3 revenue outlook of $5.65B-$6.15B.
The expectation test is whether broad industrial/data-center/automotive recovery sustains enough utilization to validate recent capacity investment and preserve free-cash-flow economics.

risks.risk: A demand relapse would leave new manufacturing capacity underutilized.

unknowns.unknown: Current valuation and peer-relative utilization remain for Alpha underwriting.
